shortDescription: Find an available port in a given range

options.name: address_family
options.description: The address family to use when checking port availability. Use C(ipv4) to bind on IPv4 or C(ipv6) to bind on IPv6.

options.name: max_attempts
options.description: Maximum number of random ports to try before giving up.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The transport protocol to check port availability for. TCP and UDP have independent port spaces, so a port may be available on one protocol but not the other.

options.name: range_end
options.description: The end of the port range to search (inclusive).

options.name: range_start
options.description: The start of the port range to search.
